overall_goal: Cook and stir the raspberry and lemon curd until thickened, then remove from heat.

goals.description: Stir the curd and lower the heat
goals.rationale: The person stirs the curd continuously, checks the cooking time, and slightly turns down the gas burner.

goals.description: Increase the heat and check the consistency of the curd
goals.rationale: The person turns up the gas burner, stirs the mixture, and lifts a spoonful to check its viscosity.

goals.description: Lower the heat and continue stirring the curd
goals.rationale: The person realizes the flame is too high, turns it down, checks the recipe and time, and continues stirring and scraping the bowl.

goals.description: Consult the recipe and test the curd's thickness
goals.rationale: The person checks other curd recipes for cooking times, stirs the mixture, and scoops some up to check if it is thick enough.

goals.description: Continue stirring the curd to ensure even cooking
goals.rationale: The person continuously stirs the raspberry and lemon curd mixture to ensure it cooks evenly without forming lumps.

goals.description: Turn off the heat and remove the mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person turns off the burner, puts on oven gloves, and carefully lifts the mixing bowl off the bain-marie to place it on the countertop.
